scope: Separate resident-process diagnostic; primary fresh-process timing unchanged

summary.scope: One separately reported cold primer and 27 matched requests in one resident process; input/model/solver/graphs rebuilt for every request. Same primary algorithms, seeds, stopping and refinement.
limitations: Three inputs and three capacities, three pre-existing primary seeds each; not the complete 30-input timing benchmark.

A persistent process amortizes startup; the first request still pays cold startup. Every subsequent request rereads input, rebuilds the incidence/model, schedules and CUDA graphs, and reloads cached modes.
Diagnostic audit and archival remain outside both clocks. Cached-mode construction and prior strategy calibration remain excluded, as in the primary cohort.
Resident times do not replace fresh-process Table 3 entries; a warm classical baseline is needed for a resident-versus-resident speed comparison.
